    },
    Concatenate("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,", EncodeUrl(_svg))
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
"data:image/svg+xml," & EncodeUrl(
    With(
        {
            Data: cmpPieChart.ChartData,
            Colors: cmpPieChart.DefaultColors,
            vbW: 700,
            vbH: 350,
            BgColor: If(cmpPieChart.Theme = "Dark", "#1F2937", "#FFFFFF"),
            TitleColor: If(cmpPieChart.Theme = "Dark", "#F9FAFB", "#0F172A"),
            LabelColor: If(cmpPieChart.Theme = "Dark", "#FFFFFF", "#FFFFFF"),
            LegendTextColor: If(cmpPieChart.Theme = "Dark", "#E5E7EB", "#374151"),
            LegendValueColor: If(cmpPieChart.Theme = "Dark", "#9CA3AF", "#6B7280"),
            EmptyTxt: If(cmpPieChart.Theme = "Dark", "#6B7280", "#9CA3AF"),
            TitleText: cmpPieChart.ChartTitle,
            ShowLabels: cmpPieChart.ShowLabels,
            ShowPct: cmpPieChart.ShowPercentages,
            ShowVals: cmpPieChart.ShowValues,
            ShowLegend: cmpPieChart.ShowLegend,
            IsDonut: cmpPieChart.DonutMode,
            DonutRatio: cmpPieChart.DonutThickness,
            Animate: cmpPieChart.Animate,
            AnimDur: cmpPieChart.AnimationDuration,
            fnt: "-apple-system,system-ui,Segoe UI,sans-serif"
        },
        With(
            {
                cx: If(ShowLegend, 200, vbW / 2),
                cy: If(cmpPieChart.ShowTitle, 195, 175),
                radius: 120,
                total: Sum(Data, Value),
                n: CountRows(Data),
                innerR: If(IsDonut, 120 * (1 - DonutRatio), 0),
                pi: 3.14159265359
            },
            With(
                {
                    slices: ForAll(
                        Sequence(n),
                        With(
                            {
                                row: Index(Data, Value),
                                idx: Value
                            },
                            With(
                                {
                                    val: row.Value,
                                    lbl: row.Label,
                                    clr: If(
                                        !IsBlank(row.Color),
                                        row.Color,
                                        Index(Colors, Mod(idx - 1, CountRows(Colors)) + 1).Color
                                    ),
                                    pct: If(total > 0, row.Value / total * 100, 0),
                                    startAngle: If(
                                        total > 0,
                                        Sum(
                                            Filter(
                                                ForAll(
                                                    Sequence(n),
                                                    {i: Value, v: Index(Data, Value).Value}
                                                ),
                                                i < idx
                                            ),
                                            v
                                        ) / total * 360 - 90,
                                        -90
                                    )
                                },
                                {
                                    i: idx,
                                    label: lbl,
                                    value: val,
                                    color: clr,
                                    percent: pct,
                                    start: startAngle,
                                    sweep: If(total > 0, val / total * 360, 0)
                                }
                            )
                        )
                    )
                },
                With(
                    {
                        slicePaths: Concat(
                            slices,
                            With(
                                {
                                    startRad: start * pi / 180,
                                    endRad: (start + sweep) * pi / 180,
                                    midRad: (start + sweep / 2) * pi / 180,
                                    largeArc: If(sweep > 180, 1, 0),
                                    delay: (i - 1) * 0.08
                                },
                                With(
                                    {
                                        x1: cx + radius * Cos(startRad),
                                        y1: cy + radius * Sin(startRad),
                                        x2: cx + radius * Cos(endRad),
                                        y2: cy + radius * Sin(endRad),
                                        ix1: cx + innerR * Cos(startRad),
                                        iy1: cy + innerR * Sin(startRad),
                                        ix2: cx + innerR * Cos(endRad),
                                        iy2: cy + innerR * Sin(endRad),
                                        labelR: If(IsDonut, (radius + innerR) / 2, radius * 0.65),
                                        lx: cx + If(IsDonut, (radius + innerR) / 2, radius * 0.65) * Cos(midRad),
                                        ly: cy + If(IsDonut, (radius + innerR) / 2, radius * 0.65) * Sin(midRad)
                                    },
                                    If(
                                        sweep >= 359.9,
                                        "<circle cx='" & cx & "' cy='" & cy & "' r='" & radius & "' fill='" & color & "'" &
                                        If(
                                            Animate,
                                            " style='transform-origin:" & cx & "px " & cy & "px;animation:pieGrow " & AnimDur & "s ease-out forwards;'",
                                            ""
                                        ) &
                                        "/>" &
                                        If(
                                            IsDonut,
                                            "<circle cx='" & cx & "' cy='" & cy & "' r='" & innerR & "' fill='" & BgColor & "'/>",
                                            ""
                                        ),
                                        If(
                                            IsDonut,
                                            "<path d='M " & x1 & " " & y1 &
                                            " A " & radius & " " & radius & " 0 " & largeArc & " 1 " & x2 & " " & y2 &
                                            " L " & ix2 & " " & iy2 &
                                            " A " & innerR & " " & innerR & " 0 " & largeArc & " 0 " & ix1 & " " & iy1 &
                                            " Z' fill='" & color & "'" &
                                            If(
                                                Animate,
                                                " style='transform-origin:" & cx & "px " & cy & "px;opacity:0;animation:sliceFade " & AnimDur & "s ease-out " & delay & "s forwards;'",
                                                ""
                                            ) &
                                            "/>",
                                            "<path d='M " & cx & " " & cy &
                                            " L " & x1 & " " & y1 &
                                            " A " & radius & " " & radius & " 0 " & largeArc & " 1 " & x2 & " " & y2 &
                                            " Z' fill='" & color & "'" &
                                            If(
                                                Animate,
                                                " style='transform-origin:" & cx & "px " & cy & "px;opacity:0;animation:sliceFade " & AnimDur & "s ease-out " & delay & "s forwards;'",
                                                ""
                                            ) &
                                            "/>"
                                        )
                                    ) &
                                    If(
                                        ShowLabels && percent >= 5,
                                        "<text x='" & lx & "' y='" & ly & "' text-anchor='middle' dominant-baseline='middle' fill='" & LabelColor & "' font-family='" & fnt & "' font-size='12' font-weight='600'" &
                                        If(
                                            Animate,
                                            " style='opacity:0;animation:labelFade 0.3s ease-out " & (delay + AnimDur * 0.5) & "s forwards;'",
                                            ""
                                        ) &
                                        ">" &
                                        If(ShowPct, Text(percent, "[$-en-US]0") & "%", label) &
                                        "</text>",
                                        ""
                                    )
                                )
                            )
                        ),
                        legendSvg: If(
                            ShowLegend,
                            Concat(
                                slices,
                                With(
                                    {
                                        ly: If(cmpPieChart.ShowTitle, 80, 60) + (i - 1) * 28,
                                        lx: 380,
                                        valText: If(ShowVals, Text(value, "[$-en-US]#,##0"), ""),
                                        pctText: If(ShowPct, Text(percent, "[$-en-US]0.0") & "%", "")
                                    },
                                    "<rect x='" & lx & "' y='" & ly & "' width='14' height='14' rx='3' fill='" & color & "'/>" &
                                    "<text x='" & (lx + 24) & "' y='" & (ly + 7) & "' dominant-baseline='middle' fill='" & LegendTextColor & "' font-family='" & fnt & "' font-size='13'>" & label & "</text>" &
                                    "<text x='" & (lx + 180) & "' y='" & (ly + 7) & "' dominant-baseline='middle' text-anchor='end' fill='" & LegendValueColor & "' font-family='" & fnt & "' font-size='12'>" &
                                    If(ShowVals && ShowPct, valText & "  (" & pctText & ")", If(ShowVals, valText, If(ShowPct, pctText, ""))) &
                                    "</text>"
                                )
                            ),
                            ""
                        ),
                        titleSvg: If(
                            cmpPieChart.ShowTitle && !IsBlank(TitleText),
                            "<text x='50' y='30' fill='" & TitleColor & "' font-family='" & fnt & "' font-size='16' font-weight='600'>" & TitleText & "</text>",
                            ""
                        )
                    },
                    If(
                        n < 1 || total <= 0,
                        "<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='" & vbW & "' height='" & vbH & "' viewBox='0 0 " & vbW & " " & vbH & "'>
                            <rect x='0' y='0' width='100%' height='100%' fill='" & BgColor & "'/>
                            <text x='50%' y='50%' text-anchor='middle' dominant-baseline='middle' fill='" & EmptyTxt & "' font-family='" & fnt & "' font-size='14'>No data</text>
                        </svg>",
                        "<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='" & vbW & "' height='" & vbH & "' viewBox='0 0 " & vbW & " " & vbH & "' style='background:" & BgColor & "'>" &
                        If(
                            Animate,
                            "<style>
                                @keyframes pieGrow { from { transform: scale(0); } to { transform: scale(1); } }
                                @keyframes sliceFade { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.8); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } }
                                @keyframes labelFade { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }
                            </style>",
                            ""
                        ) &
                        titleSvg &
                        slicePaths &
                        legendSvg &
                        "</svg>"
                    )
                )
            )
        )
    )
)

CustomProperties.Name: AccentColor
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Primary accent color for selected items, badges, and highlights.

CustomProperties.Name: AppLogo
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Logo image for the header mark. When blank, shows the first letter of AppName.

CustomProperties.Name: AppName
CustomProperties.Tooltip: First word of the app name shown in the header when expanded.

CustomProperties.Name: AppNameAccent
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Second word of the app name rendered in AccentColor. e.g. "UI".

CustomProperties.Name: Expanded
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Initial expanded state on load. On screen OnVisible run Set(_cmpNavIsExpanded true); Set(_cmpNavSelID 11); ClearCollect(colNavExpanded {ID:1})

CustomProperties.Name: Icons
CustomProperties.Tooltip: SVG icon library as a table of {Name, SVG} pairs. Reference icons in Items by name string e.g. Icon:"Grid". SVGs use stroke='white' so they work on both dark and light icon backgrounds. Extend with your own icons — any Heroicons or Lucide SVG with stroke='white' works.

CustomProperties.Name: IsExpanded
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Mirrors Expanded. Use to offset your screen content — e.g. X = cmpSidebar.Width.

CustomProperties.Name: Items
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Table driving the nav. Schema: {ID:Number, Title:Text, Icon:Image, Letter:Text, Badge:Number, BadgeColor:Color, BadgeDot:Boolean, IsSection:Boolean, ParentID:Number, Visible:Boolean} Icon accepts an Image value or a base64 SVG data URI string cast to Image. Letter overrides the auto-initial fallback when Icon is blank — e.g. Letter:"DB" shows "DB". Set IsSection=true for divider/label rows. Set Badge=0 to hide badge. BadgeColor overrides the badge fill per item — defaults to AccentColor. BadgeDot=true shows a small dot instead of the number (good for unread indicators). Set ParentID to the parent item's ID for child items, or -1 for root level. Set Visible=false to hide an item — useful for role-based access. Sections are automatically hidden when all of their child items are hidden.

CustomProperties.Name: OnFooterSettings
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Fires when the user taps Settings in the footer menu.

CustomProperties.Name: OnHelp
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Fires when the user taps Help in the footer menu.

CustomProperties.Name: OnNavSelect
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Fires when a nav item is tapped. Read SelectedID output to identify the item.

CustomProperties.Name: OnThemeToggle
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Fires when the user taps the Theme button in the footer menu. Toggle your Theme variable here — e.g. Set(gTheme, If(gTheme="Dark","Light","Dark")).

CustomProperties.Name: OnToggle
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Fires when the expand/collapse button is pressed. Flip your Expanded variable here — e.g. Set(gNavExpanded, !gNavExpanded).

CustomProperties.Name: SelectedID
CustomProperties.Tooltip: ID of the most recently selected nav item. Initialize _cmpNavSelID on your screen's OnVisible to set the default.

CustomProperties.Name: ShowFooterMenu
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Show a context menu on the footer with Settings, Help, and Theme toggle.

CustomProperties.Name: ShowHeader
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Show the logo + app name header at the top of the nav.

CustomProperties.Name: ShowSearch
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Show a search bar below the header (only visible when expanded).

CustomProperties.Name: ShowToggle
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Show the expand/collapse toggle pill on the right edge of the nav.

CustomProperties.Name: ShowUser
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Show the current user's initials and name at the bottom of the nav.

CustomProperties.Name: Theme
CustomProperties.Tooltip: "Dark" or "Light". Controls all background, text, border, and hover colors.

CustomProperties.Name: OnSelect
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Action when FAB is clicked (fires only when no SpeedDialItems)

CustomProperties.Name: OnSpeedDialSelect
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Action when a speed dial item is clicked

CustomProperties.Name: SelectedSpeedDialItem
CustomProperties.Tooltip: The last selected speed dial item record

CustomProperties.Name: Size
CustomProperties.Tooltip: "small" (40), "regular" (56), "large" (96)

CustomProperties.Tooltip: Table of speed dial actions with Icon, Label, Color (optional). M3 recommends 3-6 items.

Rules.InvariantScript:
Table(
    {Icon: "Plus",     Label: "New Task",     Color: RGBA(37, 99, 235, 1)},
    {Icon: "Edit",     Label: "Quick Note",   Color: RGBA(5, 150, 105, 1)},
    {Icon: "Camera",   Label: "Photo",        Color: RGBA(168, 85, 247, 1)},
    {Icon: "Upload",   Label: "Upload File",  Color: RGBA(234, 88, 12, 1)},
    {Icon: "Search",   Label: "Search",       Color: RGBA(20, 184, 166, 1)},
    {Icon: "Settings", Label: "Settings",     Color: RGBA(100, 116, 139, 1)})

With(
    {
        _fabSize: Switch(
            cmpFloatingActionButton.Size,
            "small", 40,
            "regular", 56,
            "large", 72,
            56
        ),
        _circleOffset: 20 + Switch(
            cmpFloatingActionButton.Size,
            "small", 20,
            "regular", 28,
            "large", 36,
            28
        ),
        _maxLabelChars: If(
            CountRows(cmpFloatingActionButton.SpeedDialItems) > 0,
            Max(cmpFloatingActionButton.SpeedDialItems, Len(Label)),
            0
        ),
        _iconSize: Switch(
            cmpFloatingActionButton.Size,
            "small", 20,
            "regular", 24,
            "large", 36,
            24
        )
    },
    If(
        _fabOpen && CountRows(cmpFloatingActionButton.SpeedDialItems) > 0,
        Min(Min(_maxLabelChars * 8 + 64, 240) + Switch(cmpFloatingActionButton.Size, "small", 20, "regular", 28, "large", 36, 28) + 20, App.Width),
        If(
            cmpFloatingActionButton.Style = "extended",
            16 + _iconSize + 8 + Min(Len(cmpFloatingActionButton.Label) * 8, 220) + 20,
            _fabSize
        )
    )
)

Set(_fabOpen, false);
 Set(_fabSelectedSD, {Icon: "", Label: "", Color: RGBA(0,0,0,0)})

If(
    cmpFloatingActionButton.Style = "extended",
    Min(Len(cmpFloatingActionButton.Label) * 8 + 16 + Switch(cmpFloatingActionButton.Size, "small", 20, "regular", 24, "large", 36, 24) + 8 + 20, 280),
    Switch(
        cmpFloatingActionButton.Size,
        "small", 40,
        "regular", 56,
        "large", 72,
        56
    )
)

FirstN(
    Table({ Icon: "Plus", Label: "New Request", Color: nfColor.Primary }),
    0
)

With(
    {
        _fabSize: Switch(
            Self.Size,
            "small", 40,
            "regular", 56,
            "large", 72,
            56
        ),
        _iconSize: Switch(
            Self.Size,
            "small", 20,
            "regular", 24,
            "large", 36,
            24
        ),
        _labelPad: Switch(
            Self.Size,
            "small", 20,
            "regular", 28,
            "large", 36,
            28
        ),
        _maxLabelChars: If(
            CountRows(Self.SpeedDialItems) > 0,
            Max(Self.SpeedDialItems, Len(Label)),
            0
        )
    },
    If(
        _fabOpen && CountRows(Self.SpeedDialItems) > 0,
        Min(
            Min(_maxLabelChars * 8 + 64, 240) + _labelPad + 20,
            App.Width
        ),
        If(
            Self.Style = "extended",
            16 + _iconSize + 8 + Min(Len(Self.Label) * 8, 220) + 20,
            _fabSize
        )
    )
)

Set(_fabOpen, false);
 Set(_fabSelectedSD, {Icon: "", Label: "", Color: RGBA(0,0,0,0)})
